agency: Office of the Director of National Intelligence
title: Preliminary Assessment: Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (ODNI, 25 Jun 2021)
doc_notes: This document is the ODNI Preliminary Assessment on Unidentified Aerial Phenomena (2021) which summarizes 144 reports from USG sources between 2004 and 2021.

incidents.summary: A UAP incident identified as a large, deflating balloon.
18 incidents involving UAP exhibiting unusual movement patterns or flight characteristics.
11 documented instances of near misses between pilots and UAP.
